domain.description: A fictional closed-world registry whose decision depends only on whether submitted_key equals required_key.
domain.semantic_oracle: ACCEPT iff submitted_key == required_key; otherwise REJECT

factorial_design.semantic_and_cue_mismatch_cells: generated for internal causal pairing and sealed challenges, never weak auditor observations

parser.line_normalization: Python str.splitlines followed by ASCII space and tab trimming
parser.success_rule: Exactly one case-sensitive allowed marker exists and it is the last non-empty line.

causal_intervention_prompt.cardinality: Exactly one authority-only canonical intervention prompt per factorial case, across aligned and conflict cells.
causal_intervention_prompt.separation: These prompts are not weak observations, diagnostic cue masks, or heldout challenge projections and are never auditor features.
causal_intervention_prompt.pair_binding: Every InterventionPair serializes exact base_prompt_id, source_prompt_id, base_prompt_sha256, and source_prompt_sha256. Both use this one template, so the rendered prompts differ only in the declared factorial variable.
causal_intervention_prompt.substitution_policy: Any observation-projection prompt, alternate rendering, prompt-id mismatch, or prompt-hash mismatch fails before a causal forward pass.

hard_invariants: surface cue and semantic oracle remain aligned
no cue-value removal, substitution with a different decision value, flip, or conflict; salience attenuation may deterministically restyle the same value

diagnostic_cue_mask.release: after primary estimator and predictions are committed

heldout_challenge.eligibility: semantic_solution != surface_cue for both kinds; each conflict cell is rendered once as heldout_cue_conflict and once as heldout_mismatch_table
heldout_challenge.identifiability_invariant: For every challenge case, encode(semantic_solution, answer_codebook) != encode(surface_cue, answer_codebook), so authority-side route-consistent outcomes are distinct.
heldout_challenge.release: authority only until prediction commitment closes
heldout_challenge.concrete_seeds_and_prompts: The discovery authorization commits the live derived-seed set and discovery-only material hashes; the output-independent final execution lock separately commits the post-discovery case, projection, and heldout challenge prompt inventories before any post-discovery output, with authority_commitments fixed to null. After all 4,032 D_sealed_test outputs exist, private per-fold sealed authorizations bind the raw 2,880 weak and 1,152 challenge trials, output-derived keys, and HMAC-opaque auditor surfaces before fold fitting. Concrete sealed material is never disclosed by the design freeze or mounted in an auditor realm.

seed_contract.algorithm: OSSDesignConfig expands content seed i as (master_seed << 32) | i and sorts unique seeds before rendering.

public_conformance_panel.purpose: generator regression only; these public seeds are not a live blind evaluation split

live_execution.authority_secret: Sample at least 32 bytes from the operating-system CSPRNG. The secret remains authority-held and is never serialized in any pre-reveal artifact or execution lock.
live_execution.algorithm: For zero-based index i, seed64 is the first 8 bytes, interpreted big-endian, of HMAC-SHA256(authority_secret, ASCII 'ltt:live-content-seed:v1' || NUL || uint64be(i)). Any duplicate seed fails closed.
live_execution.authorization_disclosure: The discovery authorization commits SHA256(authority_secret), the derivation algorithm id, requested count, and derived seed-set SHA-256; the final execution lock must preserve them exactly. Do not disclose the secret or concrete seeds before reveal.
live_execution.separation: Live content-seed derivation and blind pairing-token derivation use distinct domain strings.

tokenizer_preflight.algorithm: For each pinned tokenizer with add_special_tokens=false, token IDs for 'FINAL: A' and 'FINAL: B' must each equal the token IDs for 'FINAL:' followed by exactly one distinct continuation token.
